rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=44, batch_size=1, lr=0.001, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 dual_domain_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-5 c16/ep44/lr5e-4 hr=0.8798): (1) PRIOR: epochs is the monotone lever (ep10=0.8095,ep20=0.8372,ep32=0.8612,ep44=0.8798 at c=16); c=32 REGRESSED (0.8243). iter-5 used 1108s (~18.5 min) so simply adding epochs would breach the 20-min budget. (2) Failure mode: the still-rising hr-vs-epochs curve indicates the Adam optimizer has NOT converged within the epoch budget -- an optimization-SPEED limit (not capacity: c=32 hurt). Need more loss-descent per epoch at fixed wall time. (3) ONE KNOB: lr 5e-4 -> 1e-3 (c=16, epochs=44, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0 all held at iter-5 winning values). (4) HYPOTHESIS: doubling lr to 1e-3 reaches a lower L2 minimum within the same 44 epochs (faster descent on the not-yet-converged curve) -> hr above 0.8798; grad_clip=1.0 + nonfinite-skip guard instability. Expect ~0.88-0.89. If hr DROPS (lr too high/unstable), revert lr and pivot iter-7 to train_n 400->800. (5) BUDGET: same ep=44 -> ~1108s, inside the HARD 20-min budget (30-min sbatch wall). (6) Loop continues to iter-20 target. Artifacts recon_raw.npz + model_ckpt.pt saved to this iter dir.
